headline: Zhu Rongji: The prime minister who led China's economy into the modern era died at the age of 97
summary: Zhu Rongji served as China's prime minister from 1998 to 2003. He is regarded as an iconic figure of the country's economic reform.
why: Zhu oversaw key market-oriented reforms in China, which shaped the economic framework that global investors still track.
